_comment: Round-249 bilingual fixtures for Embeddings. Used by embeddings_describe_challenge.sh + challenges/runner/main.go to verify UTF-8 / non-ASCII text round-trips losslessly through every provider's EmbedBatch path. CONST-046 alignment (no hardcoded English-only assumption).

inputs.text: Hello, world! Embeddings turn text into vectors.
Здраво, свете! Уграђивања претварају текст у векторе.
こんにちは、世界！埋め込みはテキストをベクトルに変換します。
مرحبا بالعالم! التضمينات تحول النص إلى متجهات.
你好，世界！嵌入将文本转换为向量。

expected_invariants.byte_preservation: Input text bytes MUST reach the provider HTTP request body unchanged (UTF-8 preserved through json.Marshal).
expected_invariants.dim_consistency: Every embedding returned by a provider client MUST have exactly Client.Dimensions() float32 values.
expected_invariants.index_ordering: EmbedBatch MUST place the embedding for inputs[i] at outputs[i] regardless of server-side ordering.
expected_invariants.interface_contract: Every Client MUST implement provider.EmbeddingProvider — verified by compile-time blank assignment.
